verdict.rationale: Airbyte's documented dbt Cloud integration lets you create and run dbt transformations immediately after syncs in Airbyte Cloud, so dbt is triggered by the load rather than by a separate timer. Its API can also be driven by orchestrators like Airflow to sequence loads and transformations. missing for 10: evidence that this works outside Airbyte Cloud (self-hosted/OSS), dbt Core support without dbt Cloud, detail on failure handling or conditional triggering, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
